about: Where the giant mosquito's joints are, for tools/rig-insect.py. Each point is [across, up, forward] in metres, measured on the model as it came from Meshy, with its lowest point on the ground: across is to its left, up is from the ground, forward is toward its head. tools/joint-views.py draws the model on a grid to read these from, and draws these over it. Each leg is a list of points from where it leaves the body to its tip, with a bone between each pair. This model's two middle legs came out as one leg under the middle of the body, so it has five legs.
